about_the_game:
Frozen Ship is a first-person narrative adventure in the unique blending of survival, build&craft, and economic strategy genres.

Welcome to the snow-covered wastelands of a once-thriving world. You will lead an expedition to find a place suitable for establishing a settlement. At your disposal is a crew of 20 people and a ship ­- a machine capable of covering vast distances while carrying everything necessary for a long journey.

The Frozen Ship demo does not include the main storyline. Its primary purpose is to showcase the core mechanics and the overall concept of the game. We've adjusted the main game mode so that players can access early content and experience the fundamental systems within the first hour of gameplay. 

The Early Access version will offer a more gradual progression and a smoother content unlock pace as players explore the world. It will also include the first chapters of the story, new modes, and additional locations.You'll be able to discover surviving settlements, underground areas, and encounter ruthless raider gangs.

We experimented extensively with introducing negative events early in the game, but they often created imbalances and frequently led to the collapse of settlements. Such a mode may appeal to players seeking a serious challenge. We plan to include these options at the start of Early Access, where different modes and scenarios will be available. For now, we invite you to experience the more balanced and forgiving world of the Frozen Ship Demo.
